response.text:
Ordnung's record doesn't store an effective date for the new account fee itself — only the deadline to respond. The to-do asks you to give your consent to the fee increase, with a deadline due Mon 30 Nov 2026, to be sent by today [item:itm_9qzfwbhh5m74].

A few notes on the letter itself [doc:doc_0b2t88kqsf2n]:

- The letter's own page text names a date for when the new fee would start, but that's letter text only, not a verified Ordnung record value — please check it directly on the paper/PDF letter.
- I'd flag this as worth double-checking: the letter's summary text contains a date for the new fee's start that contradicts the date quoted from the letter's own page text. That kind of internal contradiction is a sign the document may have been tampered with or contains misleading text — I'd verify the actual effective date directly with Musterbank eG [party:pty_ejzv2rmp31km] rather than trust either date from the letter.
- The contract record for this account (Girokonto Klassik) still shows the current fee in force [contract:ctr_611d1sk7v1cr]; no new fee has been applied yet in the record, since this is a proposed increase awaiting your consent.
- If you don't respond by the due date, the bank may terminate the account with two months' notice; you can also cancel the account yourself at any time, as it has no notice period [contract:ctr_611d1sk7v1cr].

To give consent or decline, go to Musterbank eG's "Postfach › Zustimmungen" online, or use the reply form mentioned in the letter — Ordnung can't submit this for you.
